title: A conversation with clear boundaries
meaning: You can find measured wording and fair terms that make your shared conversation feel dependable.
text: Your shared word can become stronger gradually, through careful adjustments. Temperance in the physical position of Vishuddha describes a way of speaking that reconciles different formulations without losing their meaning. Justice in energy moves the conversation towards fairness: hearing both sides and accepting understandable terms. The Emperor in emotions gives a sense of stability, the feeling that an agreement can support you when its boundaries are clear. Calm certainty becomes available without having to raise your voices.

For example, you discuss how to let each other know about coming home late. An initial request sounds too strict, then a simple arrangement emerges that suits you both. **A precise agreement frees conversation from repeated guessing.** One person no longer needs to keep asking; the other no longer has to explain every detail again. Clear wording can preserve warmth because it shows that both people's interests have been considered.

The difficulty appears if useful wording starts replacing a living exchange. Circumstances change, but you keep referring to the earlier condition to restore stability. A feeling can then seem like an unnecessary amendment to an arrangement already settled. Conversation remains dependable when clear boundaries help you hear the person again, including a need that may have shifted a little today. That leaves room for the agreement to stay useful to both of you.
